newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end higher on selective buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end higher on selective buying.

text.p: Shares on the Delhi bourse closed smartly higher on Thursday as foreign investors and speculators made selective purchases, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange sensitive index recovered 9.48 points to close at 782.53. It was 0.80 point down after the first 30 minutes of trade.
Brokers said a fresh spell of buying by the local mutual funds also pushed up stock prices.
"Today's recovery was due as market had bottomed out in the past several sessions," said Surinder Gulati of brokers Share Academy.
Reliance Industries ended right rupees higher at 289.
State Bank of India firmed 4.75 rupees at 314.75.
Oriental Bank of Commerce quoted 2.25 rupees higher at 75.80.
ITC rose 8.30 rupees to 417.60 on buying by foreign institutional investors.
Larsen and Toubro added 3.95 rupees at 232.40.
